# vaultwarden_item_attachment (Resource)

This resource attaches a file to an item, in the personal vault of the provider user or in an organization. The file is encrypted like Bitwarden clients do: with its own attachment key, which is encrypted with the key of the item.

Attachments cannot be changed: a different content or file name replaces the attachment. Changes to the content are detected with its SHA-256 hash (`content_sha256`), so changing only the path of `file` keeps the attachment. Empty files are not supported. Use the `vaultwarden_item_attachment` ephemeral resource to read the content of an attachment.

Vaultwarden limits the storage of attachments with `USER_ATTACHMENT_LIMIT` and `ORG_ATTACHMENT_LIMIT`, and accepts files up to 525 MB.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_item_secure_note" "server" {
  name = "Web server"
}

# Attach a file. Changing the file on disk replaces the attachment
resource "vaultwarden_item_attachment" "certificate" {
  item_id = vaultwarden_item_secure_note.server.id
  file    = "${path.module}/certs/server.pem"
}

# Attach generated text, with an explicit file name
resource "vaultwarden_item_attachment" "config" {
  item_id   = vaultwarden_item_secure_note.server.id
  file_name = "config.json"
  content   = jsonencode({ listen = ":443" })
}

# Attach binary content
resource "vaultwarden_item_attachment" "keystore" {
  item_id        = vaultwarden_item_secure_note.server.id
  file_name      = "keystore.p12"
  content_base64 = filebase64("${path.module}/certs/keystore.p12")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) ID of the item to attach the file to. Changing it replaces the attachment

### Optional

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Content of the attachment, as a UTF-8 string. Requires `file_name`
- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) Content of the attachment, base64-encoded, for binary files. Requires `file_name`
- `file` (String) Path of the file to attach. Exactly one of `file`, `content` and `content_base64` must be set
- `file_name` (String) Name of the attachment. Defaults to the name of `file`. Changing it replaces the attachment

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the content of the attachment
- `id` (String) ID of the attachment
- `size` (Number) Size of the encrypted attachment in bytes
- `size_name` (String) Size of the encrypted attachment in a human-readable form, such as `1.2 KB`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the item ID and the attachment ID, separated by a slash
terraform import vaultwarden_item_attachment.example <item_id>/<attachment_id>
```
